labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: New generic SpeedColumn is a new feature; no existing column provides a custom unit.

body:
This is a feature request, so per the [feature request template](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE) it needs approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before it can be taken further as an issue.

Rich has no generic speed column today. [`TaskProgressColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) only shows speed when `total` is unknown, and it uses a fixed "it/s" unit. [`TransferSpeedColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) covers byte speeds only. Related: #3835 (speed with a known total in `TaskProgressColumn`).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
